channel.title: Cityside Journalism Initiative - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cityside Journalism Initiative (berkeleyside.org)

item.title: Remembering Ann Morgan Jensen, longtime UC Berkeley librarian
item.description: Jensen also led programs at the Berkeley library and Alta Bates, counseled incarcerated young women through Alameda County Girl’s Home and held librarian roles at the Lawrence Hall of Science and Stanford.

item.title: Berkeley nonprofit merges Jewish study with artmaking and the creative life
item.description: The Jewish Studio Project, co-founded by a rabbi whose mother was an art therapist, celebrates its 10th anniversary next month.

item.title: Deadly lookalikes: Mushroom poisoning surge hits immigrant communities harder
item.description: Health experts say people used to foraging elsewhere in the world are confusing death caps with edible, visually similar mushrooms found in their home countries, and hospitalizations and deaths are on the rise.

item.title: Berkeley’s public works chief leaving for East Contra Costa County
item.description: Terrance Davis, praised for his “steady hand” after taking over an embattled department reeling from high-profile departures, will be deputy city manager in Brentwood.

item.title: Police warn of ‘aggressive’ door-to-door contractor scam targeting older Berkeleyans
item.description: The scammers say they just happened to notice a problem they can fix quickly and cheaply, then tear chunks out of roofs so they can press victims to hire them to repair, police say.

item.title: Remembering Todd Walker, Berkeley street outreach worker and youth football coach
item.description: He worked as a UC Berkeley custodian and in the funeral industry, and spent his life offering food, kindness, conversation, dignity and love to those who had the least.

item.title: Shop Talk: Barnes & Noble College takes over Cal student stores; Free People opens on Fourth Street
item.description: The owners of Elements in Elmwood are retiring, Aiken returns to Fourth Street and Stella Carakasi Designer Outlet moves in the Gilman District.

item.title: Smoked duck sandwiches, chia seed pudding, and tater tots: Introducing the new Ohlone-crafted cafe at Lawrence Hall of Science
item.description: The UC Berkeley science center launched 'ammatka from Vincent Medina and Louis Trevino in February as part of its larger 'ottoy initiative.

item.title: Celebrating Betty Reid Soskin’s life: Civil Rights storyteller, park ranger, songstress
item.description: About 1,000 people gathered in Oakland Sunday to honor “Miss Betty,” once the nation’s oldest park ranger and co-founder of Reid’s Records in Berkeley.

item.title: Bay Area lawmakers rebuke Trump over Iran strikes, war authority
item.description: U.S. Rep. Lateefah Simon said the attacks "demonstrate once again President Trump’s callous disregard for the rule of law." Protesters gathered over the weekend in Oakland and San Francisco.
